title: Organic composition of ultrafine particles formed from automotive braking
content:
Environ. Sci.: Processes Impacts, 2025, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D5EM00654F, Paper
A. E. Thomas, V. Perraud, M. Lee, B. Rojas, M. E. Cooke, L. M. Wingen, P. S. Bauer, M. Dam, B. J. Finlayson-Pitts, J. N. Smith
Ultrafine particles formed from automotive braking comprise a complex array of UV-absorbing organic compounds, some of which could serve as atmospheric markers for source apportionment.
